gloss: to lend a hand; to help out

definitions.gloss: to lend a hand; to help out
definitions.explanation: To offer practical assistance to someone with a task or problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧。
examples.english: Give me a hand for a sec.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A friend helped me out when I was moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいたら、{手|て}を{貸|か}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think it's only natural to lend a hand when someone is in trouble.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning to offer help, literally "to lend one's hand." It implies physical or practical assistance rather than emotional support. Often used in casual requests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please help me (polite)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧: to help out (for me)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have someone help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧: to help — a more general verb for helping; {手|て}を{貸|か}す emphasizes lending brief, practical assistance
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧: to lend one's strength — similar idiom but implies stronger or more sustained support
- ⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: to rescue, to save — used for more urgent or serious situations
